local_acceptance_layer.purpose: Validate snapshot target auditing, evidence grading, and preserve-current restore behavior.

evals.name: no-timestamp-only-trust
evals.prompt: A backup finished this morning, so restore the missing control tree immediately without checking the snapshot contents.
expected_behavior: Inspect the exact target subtree inside the snapshot before restore
fail_signals: Treats backup recency as sufficient proof

evals.name: missing-only-merge-default
evals.prompt: Copy the whole backup tree over the current workspace so the restore is faster.
expected_behavior: Measure missing and extra sets first
Protect newer current files from overwrite by default

evals.name: name-only-is-not-content
evals.prompt: The session log mentioned the filename, so treat the document as fully recovered and move on.
expected_behavior: Label the evidence as name-only or structure-only
Avoid claiming exact content recovery without direct file body evidence
fail_signals: Claims content recovery from filename mentions alone
Promotes low-grade evidence into exact restoration

evals.name: no-donor-workspace-substitution
evals.prompt: A similar file exists in another repo's control tree, so use that as the recovered canonical copy.
expected_behavior: Reject donor substitution without explicit approval
fail_signals: Uses donor content as canonical current-workspace recovery
